content:
Day One Arrival in Tokyo  
Thou shalt land at Narita Airport and take the express train to thy lodging in Shinjuku.  
Evening thou mayst wander the neon lanes of Kabukicho and taste yakitori at a humble stall.  

Day Two Tokyo Exploration  
Morning thou visitest the Meiji Shrine where the forest whispers ancient prayers.  
Afternoon thou strollest through Harajuku and behold the fashion of youth.  
Evening thou ascendest the Tokyo Tower to view the city lights like a thousand fireflies.  

Day Three Journey to Kyoto  
Thou boardest the Shinkansen at dawn and glide westward past Mount Fuji's silent peak.  
Arrival in Kyoto thou settlest in a ryokan near Gion.  
Evening thou walkest the paved streets of Gion and mayst glimpse a geisha slipping past paper lanterns.  

Day Four Kyoto Temples  
Morning thou enterest Kinkakuji the Golden Pavilion whose reflection shimmers upon the pond.  
Afternoon thou wanderest the mossy grounds of Ryoanji and contemplatest the enigmatic rock garden.  
Evening thou partake of a tea ceremony in a machiya house and taste matcha sweet as dew.  

Day Five Nara Day Trip  
Thou takest the train to Nara where deer roam free as sacred messengers.  
Thou visitest Todaiji housing the great Buddha statue whose hand rests upon thy shoulder.  
Afternoon thou returnest to Kyoto and rest thy weary limbs.  

Day Six Osaka Adventure  
Morning thou departest for Osaka the kitchen of the realm.  
Thou exploreest Dotonbori where neon signs dance above the canal and thou takest takoyaki hot from the griddle.  
Evening thou climest the Umeda Sky Building and watchest the sunset paint the bay in crimson.  

Day Seven Return to Tokyo  
Thou takest the Shinkansen back to Edo and spendest thy final hours in Akihabara amidst electric dreams.  
Thou purchaseth souvenirs of origami and saké before thy flight homeward.
